args.name: Make a simple branch digging tool
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method to fashion an owned branch into a simple digging tool, if feasible, with measurable tool condition and actual usefulness established through use rather than description.
args.conditions: I own 1.8 branch units before further trials and stand outdoors on ordinary forest soil. A press trial at intensity 0.25 held with flexibility 0.2. No accessible local water was available for wetting. I have not established branch suitability for toolmaking.
args.inputs: Owned branch material; any additional necessary materials or tools must be specified and acquired. Method and required quantities are unknown.
args.costs: Unknown; specify realistic time, effort, material consumption, prerequisites and failure risks.
args.effects: If physically feasible and successfully performed, produce a simple personally usable digging tool. Do not assume improved gathering, a completed item, or mastery merely from this request.

candidates.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Crack the hard casing of your own shelled material, such as hazelnuts, in 0.1 blocks with controlled impacts of your own hard blunt striker on a stable support, and take the loose casing off opened blocks by hand to separate the kernel.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. target: your own unreserved, untreated item of a material with a represented casing (closed for crack modes, cracked unseparated for separate); quantity: exact tenths, 0.1-1 (default all, up to 1), reserved in one work (workId). Crack modes need striker (your own whole, rigid, sound inedible piece, e.g. a stone) and support (a solid inedible object in reach, not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground), pinned for the work. Per 0.1 block: one cracking round, 1 energy; in crack-and-separate a block that opens adds one separation round, 0.5 energy; separate: one hand round, 0.5 energy per block. 0.9 units: at most 18 rounds, 13.5 energy. quoteOnly true reports quantity, striker condition, phases, maximum energy and wear bounds at no cost. pause, resume, cancel: one round, no energy. Checks run before any charge; failed rechecks pause open work at no charge. Travel and getting a striker are separate actions.
candidates.effects: Strength is hardness / 10; an impact passes the lower of striker and support strength x (1 - flexibility). At or below the casing strength the casing is unchanged: a real paid result that ends the work, the material returns as it was. Above it a block gains damage (load - strength) / strength: below 1 closed and damaged (a reattempt is new work), at 1 fractured open. Separation takes an opened block apart into 0.1 loose kernel and 0.1 casing fragments (a unit of each is that part of one whole unit) with the source origin, age and decay; the kernel carries all food value and toxicity, whatever they are. Opened blocks not separated stay cracked unseparated material. Wear: a striker no harder than what it strikes, or a support softer by 0.5 than what presses on it, loses 0.0001 kg per contact. Cancel returns reserved material as it now is; death leaves it at the worksite. Nothing is refunded, made safe or eaten; edibility, nutrition and toxins stay unknown; no reward.

candidates.function: Hand owned units to an adjacent actor.
candidates.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

candidates.function: Scoop a little river or shallow water by hand and pour it onto the soil plot of a rooted plant whose measured soil is drier than it needs.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. collect (x, y: a visible ~ or = cell whose edge is within 0.65 m of you on the bank): 1 round, 0.3 energy; fills cupped hands to 0.2 L (or an owned water vessel given as container to its capacity). water (target: a rooted growing plant in reach; quantityLitres optional, default all held, at most 0.5): 1 round, 2 energy per litre poured (at least 0.05). status (target optional): 1 round, no energy. Refused before any cost, with the measured values, when soil moisture already meets the plant requirement (berry 0.6, root 0.5, tuber 0.8, fern-root 0.7), the plot is waterlogged (hazard waterlogging above 0.1 or moisture 1.3+), the target is not a rooted plant, or no water is held.
candidates.effects: Hand water is not an item: 40% of what is left leaks at each round end and 20% per metre walked; below 0.005 L it is gone. A pour loses 20% (from a vessel 5%) outside the root zone. The rest enters the root zone of the plant cell (1 m x 1 m, shared by every plant rooted there): 30 L raise soil moisture by 1; above 1.3 it runs off; above 1 half the excess drains each round; 10% evaporates each round (at most 0.0375 L). Soil moisture, which growth reads as min(1, moisture / requirement), includes it until it is gone. Growth is not boosted or promised. No reward.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general operation for shaping and using simple wooden digging implements. The supplied related-capability search found probe, consult and exchange, but none establishes manufacture or tool-mediated soil displacement; controlled casing impacts are not equivalent to shaping wood. No query batches remain, and incomplete search results are not proof of absence: the current-conversation development handoff must check the retained complete contracts for an argument-level equivalent before adding code, and record any reuse. Current owned branch stock is 1.6 units, not the request's earlier 1.8. The verified 0.25-load hold and 0.5-load failure constrain expectations but do not establish suitable dimensions, a sound blank, or a finished tool. Missing shaping, condition and soil-interaction mechanisms belong in development, not permanent rejection.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool, parameterized by owned target, quantity, abrasive/support references, soil target, workId and mode; modes inspect, shape, trial/use, maintain, pause, resume and cancel share one implementation. Minimal manufacture method is controlled abrasion of an existing suitable wooden end; no cutting edge, fire, water or binding is assumed. Dependencies: existing ownership/reservation, reach, item provenance, energy/time and event systems; reuse probe's observation/material-response implementation where applicable and record exact reused IDs, versions and functions in the handoff. Add missing material-removal, tool-condition and localized soil-displacement code in that same handoff. No execution or world time passes during review/development.\\nPrerequisites and references: name the actual owned unreserved stock item, quantity in supported increments, and an individually identifiable blank selected from it. For this applicant the candidate source is item-9-moss-89, currently 1.6 branch units. The root item item-2-moss-11 is not an ingredient. Require actual reachable firm support and an owned or otherwise legitimately usable, reachable abrasive surface whose physical properties permit wood removal; none is granted or presumed available. Ground may provide support only if actually stable. A suitably rough stone must be found/acquired if no usable abrasive surface exists. Inspection must establish accessible dimensions, structural condition and an achievable rounded or tapered working end; aggregate stock quantity alone does not prove there is a coherent blank. Missing dimensions/material properties must be represented and checked through ordinary local inspection, without exposing remote stock or unrelated hidden attributes. Quote unavailable prerequisites rather than inventing them. No water is required.\\nCosts and progress: study takes 4 rounds individually, without granting material, completed work or mastery. A committed local inspection takes 1 round and 0.5 energy and returns only observable facts. Select a valid blank quantity q, at least the material system's minimum increment, with q no greater than owned unreserved stock. Before commitment, quote q, predicted removal bound, number of abrasion strokes/rounds, energy and support/abrasive wear from implemented material and geometry rules. Each shaping work round performs one bounded abrasion stroke for 1 energy; at most four strokes per submitted work segment, with explicit continuation for more. A smaller end can be made only as fast as the implemented removal rate permits. A zero-removal contact still costs its actual round and effort and reports failure to abrade. Abrasive/support damage is calculated per actual contact; unsupported or physically incapable material is not silently effective. A trial/use stroke takes 1 round and 1 energy; a maintenance stroke takes 1 round and 1 energy and uses the same abrasion/removal rules. No charges occur for a rejected precondition or a read-only work/condition quote. Do not silently commit extra segments or gather prerequisites.\\nManufacture and conservation: reserve the identified blank and any exclusively required implements while work is active. Track removed material, taper/end dimensions, remaining cross-section, cracks and actual condition after every stroke. Transfer removed wood into attributable debris at the worksite, preserving source identity and total represented mass; abrasive wear likewise becomes accounted debris. Resource units must use the existing material-to-mass convention rather than treating one branch unit as an invented kilogram. The blank plus wood debris must equal the input wood mass, with no new food or other resource produced. Release a shaped item only when the measured geometry meets the declared end-shape criterion and sufficient shaft remains; retain an unfinished or damaged blank otherwise. An item may be visibly shaped without being verified useful. Quantity reserved is not quantity destroyed.\\nUse and useful effects: require a particular reachable, physically represented soil patch, a held tool, a chosen bounded stroke/load and sufficient condition. Resolve each stroke against the actual end geometry, tool response, soil resistance, displacement and obstruction rules in code. If those rules do not exist, implement the minimal bounded loose-surface-soil interaction rather than simulating success through a label. Start trials at no more than the previously observed 0.25 load where that calibration is applicable; this is not a guarantee for a shaped or different piece. Do not extrapolate the failed 0.5 load as a safe operating limit. A stroke can displace only the volume supported by its actual contact and available work, capped at 0.001 cubic metres per stroke for this initial implementation. Move that same soil volume into a local loose-soil/deposit representation; do not delete soil, conjure excavation products, expose hidden resource contents or automatically gather anything. Report measured displaced volume, penetration if represented, tool deformation/damage and energy paid, including zero displacement. Establish tool usefulness only after an actual nonzero tool-mediated soil displacement event. A failure may damage or break the tool, with fragments conserved; it cannot grant a successful-tool state. No automatic gathering multiplier, excavation of hard ground, improved nutrition or unrelated effectiveness is included.\\nPersistence, maintenance and stopping: work records retain exact source, tool, abrasive, support and soil IDs, reserved quantities, phase, strokes completed, cumulative time/energy, debris and condition. Recheck ownership/access, reach, physical prerequisites and sufficient energy before each paid stroke. Missing prerequisites, movement, exhaustion or interruption pause work with completed changes intact and no charge for an unexecuted stroke. Pause/resume/cancel are controls with no material/energy charge; they cause no physical progress. Resume requires actual return and revalidation of the recorded inputs, with stale geometry/condition recomputed if another legitimate action changed them. Cancellation releases all remaining inputs in their present condition; already spent time, energy and material wear are never refunded. Death ends the actor's work and releases tangible remaining inputs, unfinished tools and debris at the worksite under ordinary death/ownership rules, without duplication or automatic delivery. Study retains only completed study progress under the existing learning rules and requires a living actor to continue. Tools retain wear and environmental deterioration under explicit item rules; maintenance removes real additional material and cannot restore lost mass or heal structural cracks for free. Stop use at the implemented breakage/unsafe-condition threshold. No autonomous digging, maintenance or resource production occurs after the action or while paused. Other participants must communicate and act through their own interfaces; none is enrolled or made to consent by this operation.\",\"learning\":4,\"experienceReview\":\"No benefit for requesting, querying, naming, registering, waiting for development or completing study/mastery. Functional tool condition and soil displacement are separate from experience. A paid observation, shaping attempt or use trial may qualify for verified information gain only when it adds a personally applicable, evidenced fact, including an informative failure; deduplicate equivalent facts by material/condition/load/result rather than by new item names. After a qualifying real event, allow at most 0.1 short pleasure and a 0.01 satisfaction contribution under the existing experience system, capped at 0.02 satisfaction from this activity family and no more than one award per 10 rounds. Short pleasure expires within 2 rounds; satisfaction decays at the existing 0.002 per round and is not renewed by status calls. Familiar legitimate useful practice may renew this modest bounded benefit after the cooldown without requiring novelty, but empty repeated strokes do not qualify. Implement eligibility, caps, decay and deduplication in code, not repeated model review. Physical comfort is not awarded for manufacture and remains capped at 10 globally. Basic nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use observable events for inspection, abrasion contact, wood/debris separation, unfinished shaping, completed geometry, soil contact/displacement, wear, cracking, breakage, maintenance and interruption. Reusable visual metadata must include operation/mode, actor and target IDs, source/work IDs, material, phase, progress, end geometry, visible condition, debris amount, actual displaced volume, position and result reason. Distinguish unverified shaped tool from use-verified tool. Only an actual displacement event may show displaced earth; only completed geometry checks may show a finished end. An unavailable prerequisite, paused work, zero-removal contact, failed soil stroke or broken blank must show its corresponding blocked/incomplete/failure state, never success, glowing upgrades or invented products. Visuals reveal no unobserved resource locations, unsupported suitability or inferred happiness.\"}]}"}
